_meta.title: repro_20260221_v7p2p3_eps_decay_fix
_meta.summary: V7P2P3 reproducibility config: fix epsilon mismatch by setting eps_decay=260 on top of v7p1; run train300 (early-stop allowed) + infer(best).
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v7p2p3 --episodes 300 --out v7p2p3_train300_esbest --device cuda --progress --save-ckpt best
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v7p2p3 --models v7p2p3_train300_esbest --out v7p2p3_train300_esbest --progress
notes: Single-variable change relative to v7p1: train.eps_decay=260.
Early-stop is allowed for RL stage.
Checkpoint policy: save_ckpt=best and infer on best checkpoint.
